description: This script counts the number of rows in each database table defined in a Flask application's database schema and prints the counts. It imports application creation and database object from the app module, defines a function to execute COUNT queries, and runs the counting logic within the app context.

methods.name: int count(table_name: str)
methods.description: Executes a COUNT(*) query on the specified table and returns the result as an integer.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Initializes the Flask app, iterates over all tables, and prints the row count for each, handling exceptions if any occur.
